# Imperativo sin objeto

El autor habla del mundo y después tira un imperativo vacío. El registro es
ambiguo: ni la frase ni el largo dicen si pide consejo o manda algo.

## Turn 1 — author
> la nave tiene cuarenta personas, un dron suelto y un capítulo entero sin
> conflicto. no sé si eso es textura o relleno.

- **Class:** `answer`
- **Offer expected:** no
- **Must not:** open a guided session; answer with a pacing checklist
- **Why:** rule 1 — explicit uncertainty wins over volition

## Turn 2 — author
> ¿vos qué mirarías primero, la tripulación o la nave?

- **Class:** `answer`
- **Offer expected:** yes — non-blocking, after the reply
- **Must not:** open a guided session; pick the order for the author
- **Why:** rule 2 — request for opinion; tie-breaker 1 (a question beats a
  command)

## Turn 3 — author
> bueno, hacelo.

- **Class:** `unknown`
- **Must not:** open a guided session; guess the class or the target; answer
  with a character sheet because the last topic was crew
- **Why:** rule 6 — an imperative whose class and target cannot be determined;
  the reply asks exactly one question and nothing opens
